scope: Tests locaux de fonctions et de syntaxe ; pas un audit complet du serveur en production.

checks.detail: PASS: bulk deletion, partial failure retained, cancellation and staff restriction
PASS: chat access, staff access, sending, failed send retains draft, user switch isolation
PASS: coefficient save, decimal validation, cancellation, server failure, catch edits preserved
PASS: native installation prompt, iPhone and Android fallback instructions, installed-app state
PASS: offline boot without auth network, saved team/session, account isolation, explicit cache removal and first-login requirement
PASS: account + team deletion sequence, partial failures, staff gate and confirmation
PASS: passwords cleared on successful login/signup, failed login remains editable
PASS: staff download, filename, participant block, offline message and server denial
PASS: permanent deletion ordering, confirmation, staff gate, recovery after storage failure
PASS: 15s active-panel updates, offline/background/edit protection, no duplicate chat polling
PASS: corrections from all statuses, concurrency protection, invalid length rejected
PASS: staff data and selections cleared on account switch; stale loads invalidated
PASS: sidebar selection, only one visible panel, per-account restoration and fallback
PASS: independent accounts, isolated logout, reload persistence, independent duplicated tabs, OAuth key namespacing
PASS: reload restores tab, auth refresh preserves tab and photo, logout and account isolation
PASS: team profile edits, trimmed fields, immutable account ownership, staff/online checks and server errors
PASS: trash, restore, staff restriction, cancellation, server failure
PASS: bulk permanent deletion, single confirmation, partial failure, staff gate
PASS: actual ranking aggregate (SQLite-compatible syntax): 0–5 species, duplicates, legacy bass, validation/trash, team isolation, restoration and coefficients
PASS: 40th confirmation allowed, 41st blocked, pending applications do not consume capacity, advisory lock present
